title: Three-coordinate majority with one fixed input
statement: Let $i$ be one of the three coordinate positions, and let $a,s\in\{-1,1\}$. The majority of the three-coordinate vector whose $i$th entry is $a$ and whose other entries are both $s$ equals $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate position in a three-coordinate vector
